sources.assessment: The complete current product information was reread. It remains dated 22 September 2026 and its configured claim-bearing fingerprint is unchanged. Section 4.1 still separately authorises Wegovy injection for weight management, cardiovascular-risk reduction in eligible adults, and non-cirrhotic MASH in adults with F2 to F3 fibrosis. The MASH clinical-programme section still says the 240-week Part 2 confirmatory results are outstanding. This is UK product-authorisation evidence, not an NHS funding decision, proof of supply or an individual treatment recommendation.
